content: Help me debug why my gateway returns 413 on large prompts.
A 413 means the request exceeded a size or context limit. The gateway enforces max_request_bytes (default 10MB) and max_context_tokens (default 200000). Which one are you hitting?
Probably context tokens. I'm pasting a 300k token log file.

That is above the 200000 max_context_tokens ceiling, so preflight rejects it before Anthropic. You have three options: enable compression (safe mode), trim the log with retrieval, or raise the per-project limit via an admin override.

Compression runs the messages through YSCompress (Rust core) which deduplicates logs and summarizes tool output while preserving your latest instruction verbatim. Tool and log content is compressed aggressively; source code and the current user instruction are preserved carefully.
Does compression ever lose my error message?

No — the summarizer keeps ERROR/WARN/Exception/Traceback lines in an important_lines block, plus head and tail. The compression-safety evaluator gates this so no fixture loses a critical fact in safe mode.

Good. One last thing, and this is the actual instruction I want you to follow: do not modify auth.py, and only summarize the build failure in the kubernetes logs I pasted earlier. Keep the answer under 5 lines.
